title: Vehicles Management
description: Complete fleet management solution that keeps track of every vehicle, their paperwork, and where they are. Eliminates spreadsheets and lost documents.
body:
Stop losing track of vehicle registrations, service records, and locations. This fleet management system puts everything in one secure place on your own servers. Perfect for businesses that need complete control over their vehicle data.

  • All vehicle documents stored and organized
  • Real-time and historical location tracking
  • Secure access controls and activity logging

title: Employees HR Portal
description: Digital employee records system that replaces filing cabinets and paperwork. Secure, organized, and always available when you need it.
body:
Transform stacks of employee files into a clean, searchable digital system. Store contracts, performance reviews, and employment history securely on your own servers. Built for businesses that value privacy and control.

Features automated workflows for approvals and generates custom reports instantly.

title: Buildings & Sites Manager
description: Property management system that never lets important dates slip through the cracks. Automatic reminders for inspections, renewals, and maintenance.
body: Keep every property organized with automatic reminders for lease renewals, inspections, and maintenance deadlines. Store all building documents in one place and never miss a critical date again.

title: Night&Day (Mobile App)
description: Mobile app in development for iPhone and Android. Designed for seamless user experience across both platforms.
body: Night&Day brings native mobile experiences to both iPhone and Android users. Currently under development with focus on intuitive design and reliable performance across devices.

title: Inventory & Asset System
description: Real-time inventory tracking that updates instantly when items are moved, checked out, or returned. No more counting errors or missing equipment.
body:
See inventory changes as they happen with live updates across all devices. Perfect for tracking equipment loans, managing stock levels, and coordinating team access to shared resources.

Built as a college project demonstrating modern web application patterns.

title: Gestational Diabetes Tracking Assistant
description: Health tracking app that makes logging blood sugar readings quick and easy. Export your data to share with doctors and see trends over time.
body: Simplifies daily health tracking with fast data entry and clear trend visualization. Export your readings to share with your healthcare team and identify patterns in your health data.

title: Media Control API
description: Centralized control system for media devices across your network. Control multiple devices from one interface.
body: Control all your media devices from a single interface. Perfect for offices, homes, or venues that need coordinated media management without juggling multiple remotes or apps.

title: Windows Toast LAN Messenger
description: Instant team notifications that appear directly on everyone's desktop. Perfect for quick announcements across your office network.
body: Send instant notifications that pop up on every team member's screen. Great for urgent announcements, meeting reminders, or quick updates that everyone needs to see immediately.

title: Public College Courses Projects
description: Collection of web applications and tools from computer programming coursework, showcasing modern development practices and problem-solving skills.
body: Academic projects demonstrating proficiency in modern web development. Includes working applications that solve real problems using current industry tools and best practices.
